hits.snippet: ## What actually shipped on 3 August 2026 The announcement has three parts, and only the first is the one being reported. The collaboration itself makes Superblocks available within customer AWS environments, including Amazon Bedrock. Amazon's press release describes the deployment model directly: Superblocks "runs fully managed in the customer's own AWS environment", and AWS becomes Superblocks' preferred cloud provider, with procurement available through AWS Marketplace. The second part is infrastructure automation. Superblocks integrates with Amazon Aurora to spin up a database per generated application inside the customer VPC, with scale-to-zero capability. AWS states Aurora delivers "up to 6x the throughput of standard engines". Superblocks' own engineering post adds that when a user publishes from development to production, the platform runs migrations across environments automatically, and that S3 is provisioned the same way. ## References 1.
